subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: What replacement contract should Mattermost interaction signing use before the linked fix can merge?
rationale: The issue is real in source and release, but the fix changes a security-sensitive credential/setup boundary and may affect existing deployments unless maintainers choose durable provisioning versus explicit fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Provision a durable per-account secret
options.body: Require the Mattermost plugin to configure or persist a separate interaction secret through supported setup, SecretRef or doctor surfaces, then prove valid callbacks after restart or split execution.

options.title: Accept explicit fail-closed setup
options.body: Require operators to configure an interaction secret and make the missing-secret failure mode clear in code, docs, tests, and upgrade notes before merge.

options.title: Narrow to hardening-only
options.body: If maintainers decide bot-token possession is already inside the Mattermost/OpenClaw trust boundary, narrow the report rather than treating it as a release-blocking vulnerability.

recommendation.title: Provision a durable per-account secret
recommendation.body: Require the Mattermost plugin to configure or persist a separate interaction secret through supported setup, SecretRef or doctor surfaces, then prove valid callbacks after restart or split execution.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the original Mattermost interaction work and the adjacent callback reachability change, making them the clearest routing owner from history.
